arg.name: racecar_version
arg.description: Car configuration used for steering calibration

arg.name: sim_opp
arg.description: Control the simulated opponent using /opp_scan and /opp_drive

arg.name: max_speed
arg.description: Maximum desired speed in m/s; defaults to the YAML value

arg.name: max_deceleration
arg.description: Maximum allowed deceleration in m/s^2; defaults to the YAML value (2.5)

arg.name: minimum_gap_angle
arg.description: Minimum navigable gap width in radians; defaults to the YAML value (0.12)
